name: rc11-pass7
description: RC11's six INT8 programs of model pass 7 (guarded weight specialisation). 0x49a0c0, 0x642b40 (1440p-4K family): RC8 native streams (wave64, vector guard) + RC9 16-word pointwise chains in exact 4-output batches. The 1080p (0x522900, 0x6e05c0) and 8K (0x10fcd0, 0x34fa40) families: RC7's guarded exact FP32 lowering. All six get RC10's compiler cleanup.
